tripDescription: A compact three-day Kyoto walk covering classic temples, quiet neighborhoods, and everyday meals.

activities.title: Kiyomizu-dera
activities.description: Visit the wooden terrace early for views over the city before crowds build.
activities.tips: Wear shoes you can slip off at temple halls.
activities.transport: Bus to Gojozaka, then a short uphill walk.

activities.title: Sannenzaka & Ninenzaka
activities.description: Stroll the stone lanes between shops and small shrines toward Yasaka.
activities.tips: Keep cash handy for street snacks.

activities.title: Gion dusk walk
activities.description: Walk the quieter side streets near Shirakawa as lanterns come on.
activities.tips: Stay respectful around geisha photo spots.

activities.title: Bamboo grove & Tenryu-ji
activities.description: Pass through the bamboo path and the Zen temple garden while it is cooler.
activities.tips: Arrive close to opening to reduce crowding.

activities.title: Riverbank & monkey park optional
activities.description: Walk the river or climb to the monkey park for a city overlook if energy remains.
activities.tips: Skip the park if rain makes the path slippery.

activities.title: Return via central Kyoto
activities.description: Head back toward downtown for an easy dinner and an early night.
activities.tips: Trains get busy after sunset; leave a buffer.

meals.lunch: Tofu or yudofu set near Tenryu-ji

activities.title: Kinkaku-ji
activities.description: See the gold pavilion reflected in the pond, then continue to quieter grounds nearby.
activities.tips: Photos from the designated viewpoints only.

activities.title: Ryoan-ji rock garden
activities.description: Sit with the stone garden and keep the visit unhurried before packing up.
activities.tips: Silence phones inside the viewing hall.
activities.transport: Short bus or taxi hop from Kinkaku-ji.

activities.title: Last neighborhood stroll
activities.description: Pick souvenirs and a final walk near your hotel before departure.
activities.tips: Confirm luggage storage hours if you check out early.
